title: Gaussian fluctuations of differential observables of stationary lattice fields
summary: We study Gaussian fluctuations of differential observables of centered stationary random fields on the discrete $d$-dimensional torus of mesh $1/N$. Our main result is a Central Limit Theorem for the fields $f\mapsto N^{-d/2-m}\sum_xφ_x^N(Pf)(x/N)$, where $P$ is a scalar homogeneous constant-coefficient differential operator of order $m\geq0$ with Fourier symbol $p$, e.g., $P=Δ$ and $m=2$.
